passive.name: Bravado
passive.text: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

spells.name: Starlight's Touch
spells.text: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.

spells.name: Bastion
spells.text: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.

spells.name: Dazzle
spells.text: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.

spells.name: Cosmic Radiance
spells.text: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.

damage.value: Taric deals magic damage with two empowered basic attacks after casting an ability.

archetype.value: Taric is a support who plays aggressively in lane and helps with objectives.

axis.value: Taric favors early fights over a lane spent only farming.

winCondition.value: Taric sets up stuns and uses his ultimate to protect allies in fights.

spikes.why: Taric can make nearby allies invulnerable more often as its cooldown drops from 180 to 120 seconds.

mistakes.value: Taric loses damage, healing, shielding, and stun cooldown reduction by skipping the two auto-attacks after each ability.
Taric loses passive value when he skips the two basic attacks after casting an ability.
